import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Hundehalter und Hunde Statistik in Zürich', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Distribution of dog owners by age group
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
age_counts = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang')['HID'].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_title('Anzahl Hundehalter nach Altersgruppe', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Altersgruppe')
ax1.set_ylabel('Anzahl Hundehalter')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution by Kreis (District)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
kreis_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['HID'].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False)
kreis_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax2, color='coral', edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Anzahl Hundehalter nach Kreis', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Anzahl Hundehalter')
ax2.set_ylabel('Kreis')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Top dog breeds
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
breed_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color='mediumseagreen', edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_title('Top 10 Hunderassen', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Anzahl')
ax3.set_ylabel('Rasse')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Age distribution of dogs over years
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
yearly_data = df.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'AlterVHundLang']).size().reset_index(name='count')
pivot_data = yearly_data.pivot(index='StichtagDatJahr', columns='AlterVHundLang', values='count')
pivot_data = pivot_data.fillna(0)

# Plot stacked area chart
pivot_data.plot(kind='area', ax=ax4, alpha=0.7, stacked=True)
ax4.set_title('Altersverteilung der Hunde über die Jahre', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Jahr')
ax4.set_ylabel('Anzahl Hunde')
ax4.legend(title='Hundealter', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=8)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
